preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 100 and 0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1])
preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100) and m (0 ≤ m ≤ n(n-1)/2) representing the number of vertices and edges, respectively.
The input has exactly m + 1 lines, where the first line is n and m, and the next m lines are edges.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the m edge lines contains two distinct integers x and y (1 ≤ x, y ≤ n, x ≠ y) representing an undirected edge between vertices x and y.

preconditions.expression: all(x != y for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself (x ≠ y).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'FHTAGN!' if (exists_cycle := any(all(adj[u] == {v} for u, v in zip(cycle, cycle[1:] + cycle[:1])) for cycle in find_all_cycles(graph))) and (trees := partition_into_trees(graph, cycle)) and len(trees) >= 3 and all(is_tree(tree) for tree in trees) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'FHTAGN!' if and only if the graph contains a simple cycle (a set of vertices where each vertex is connected to exactly two others in the cycle, forming a closed loop) and the remaining graph (after removing the cycle edges) can be partitioned into three or more rooted trees, where each tree is connected and acyclic, and the roots of these trees are exactly the vertices of the cycle. Otherwise, the output is 'NO'.
